pageDesc: Install and manage VPN server and client on this host. WireGuard first; OpenVPN next.
executeOff: System changes off — install/connect need YSK_EXECUTE=1 and root.
needWireGuard: WireGuard tools required for server and client.
endpointHint: host:port clients use (public IP or domain). Leave empty to auto-detect IP.
noPeersHint: Create a named client, then download the conf or scan the QR code.
qrHint: Scan with the WireGuard mobile app.
clientIntro: Import WireGuard conf or OpenVPN .ovpn to connect this host as a client. No inbound port needed.
noProfilesHint: Paste a conf from another server (or a peer export).
installNote: One-click install: WireGuard, OpenVPN, Shadowsocks-libev when YSK_EXECUTE is on.
needSs: ss-server (shadowsocks-libev) required for ss:// access keys.
ssHonestUi: This is Shadowsocks-libev (ss:// keys + QR), not the full Outline Manager appliance.
